messages:
nisha: Heads-up — onboarding customer hit a confusing error surface during SDK auth. They saw a 400 with body 'invalid_request' when token expired, then a 500 on retry. Logs attached.
owen: Ugh, that sounds like the token refresh path isn't translating downstream errors. Can you paste the response bodies?

nisha: Sure — snippet:
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "invalid_request",
  "message": "refresh_token missing"
}
```
Then on retry we got:
```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
{
  "error": "server_error"
}
```

linh: Is the SDK mapping HTTP->typed exceptions? We should be surfacing a RefreshTokenMissingError (typed) for the first one, not a generic HttpError. Right now some languages just map by status code.
owen: Exactly. The backend returns structured error codes in the body but our mapping logic prefers status code. If we see "invalid_request" + message contains refresh_token, we should throw a specific typed exception and include a retry hint (do.not.retry / prompt reauth).
marco: From product: customers expect actionable UX. If we return a 500 on retry, that's catastrophic for onboarding flows. Could be we swallow the 400, attempt refresh, then crash on auth service momentary outage. We need clear semantics: typed exception for client/auth problems vs transient 5xx with Retry-After.
linh: Proposal: SDK should implement layered mapping: 1) body.error -> typed exception mapping table (highest priority) 2) status code heuristics (fallback) 3) include structured metadata: {code, retryable, suggestion}. For languages without structured exceptions, return an error object with these fields.
nisha: That would make debug & UI prompts easier. Also need consistent message copy — currently some SDKs say "invalid request" and others mirror the raw backend message. We should standardize to human-friendly + machine code.
owen: Implementation notes for eng-runtime: add a small middleware after HTTP decode that checks body.error and message regexes. We can centralize mapping config in resources/error-mapping.json and load per SDK. I'll open an RFC.
marco: From support: can we add a regression test in sample-apps that simulates expired refresh + auth outage? That would catch the 500-on-retry path.
linh: Agreed. Sample app should show: detect RefreshTokenMissingError -> show reauth UI. If we see 5xx with Retry-After, show spinner + exponential backoff. If both appear, prefer auth flow.
sdk-bot: [ci] lint:pass, tests:fail (error-mapping-tests). CI log: failure in go-sdk mapping tests. See https://ci.redwood.internal/1234
owen: I'll take the go-sdk failing test. Quick check: go client currently maps 400 -> BadRequestError only. It ignores body.error field. I'll add body parsing and update typed error structs.
nisha: Thanks. Can we also update onboarding doc copy to include a table of common errors and suggested UX? I'll draft.
marco: Great. Owners: owen (go/sdk mapping), linh (cross-SDK mapping schema + doc), nisha (onboarding doc + sample app test). Set p0 for next sprint.
linh: I'll post the proposed mapping table in #devex later today. @owen ping me when you have a branch so we can align test fixtures. :thumbsup:
